summary: Configured and verified Vault HTTPS/dynamic secrets on node1 and PostgreSQL TLS/DML access on node2. Persistence and reboot-time unseal services are enabled; no nodes were rebooted.
actions_performed: Created persistent Vault Raft storage, SAN-valid TLS, and automatic unseal service.
Configured PostgreSQL TLS, SCRAM, database/table, least-privilege roles, and hostssl-only access.
Configured database secrets engine, 30s/60s leases, dynamic credentials, expiry, and immediate revocation.
Created root-only client environment with the restricted application token.
Enabled UFW and systemd hardening; verified lifecycle, permissions, TLS, ACLs, and cleanup.
